text: {"kind":"final","content":"{\"answer\":\"The data shows a clear association: routes that ran over plan were much more likely to be late. Of measured deliveries 47001 deliveries, overrun deliveries 2880 had route overruns (overrun rate 6.1%). When a route overran it was late 62.6% of the time, versus 26.9% when it did not overrun. The overruns carry penalties of $102,960 and handling costs of $61,336. By weekday, Friday had overrun deliveries 614 (overrun rate 5.5%) with late when overrun 61.2% and late when not overrun 31.6%; Monday had overrun deliveries 199 with late when overrun 69.8% and late when not overrun 21.7%.\",\"refused\":false}"}
